verdict.rationale: Aider builds a repo map (concise summary of key classes/functions/signatures across the whole git repo) and offers `/map` and `/ask` commands to explore and understand a codebase without editing it, which directly supports finding where to start making changes; community testimonials corroborate this working well for unfamiliar codebases and languages. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark or deeper hands-on validation of repo-map accuracy on large/complex codebases.
